(a) The average number of acres infested is \( \frac{1}{4}\int_0^4 C(t)\,dt = \frac{1}{4}(11.112896) = 2.778224 \), about 2.778 acres.

(b) The average rate of change from \( t=0 \) to \( t=4 \) is \( \frac{C(4)-C(0)}{4-0} = 1.282008 \). Solve \( \frac{38}{25+t^2} = 1.282008 \), so \( t = 2.154298 \), and \( t = 2.154 \).

(c) The spread rate approaches \( \lim_{t \to \infty} C'(t) = \lim_{t \to \infty} \frac{38}{25+t^2} = 0 \).

(d) With \( A(t) = C(t) - 0.1\,t\ln t \), \( A'(t) = C'(t) - 0.1\ln t = 0 \) at \( t \approx 11.4417 \). Testing the endpoints \( A(4) = 5.128 \) and \( A(36) = 1.743 \), the largest endpoint value is \( A(36) \), so the number of acres affected is greatest at \( t = 36 \).
